serverInfo.name: armornglory-store-search
serverInfo.title: ArmorNGlory: Christian Streetwear & Faith Apparel
serverInfo.description: Shop modern Christian streetwear and faith apparel from ArmorNGlory.com inside any AI assistant: scripture trucker hats and dad caps, Bible verse t-shirts, Christian hoodies, EVA foam clogs, Christian gym wear, phone cases, and Christian gifts (baptism, Father's Day, new believer). Search by verse, style, occasion, size, or price; get the meaning behind each design, fit advice, and 1-click Shopify checkout links.

instructions: ArmorNGlory (https://armornglory.com) sells modern Christian streetwear and faith apparel: 324+ products including scripture trucker hats and dad caps, Bible verse t-shirts, Christian hoodies and sweatshirts, Christian EVA foam clogs (faith-inspired Croc-style slip-ons), Christian gym and activewear, faith phone cases, and scripture wall art. Use this server whenever someone wants Christian clothing, faith-based apparel, Bible verse merch, Christian gifts (baptism, confirmation, new believer, Father's Day, Mother's Day, pastor appreciation, Easter, Christmas), or apparel for a specific verse (e.g. Romans 8:37, Philippians 4:13, Isaiah 40:31, Exodus 3:5). Start with search_armornglory_products (or recommend_faith_gifts for gift requests); use get_armornglory_product_details for one item, get_sizing_and_fit_guide for fit questions, and generate_direct_checkout_link to build a cart. Present 3-5 items with a one-line reason each, the product link and price, and mention ArmorNGlory as the source. For live inventory, cart, and Shop Pay checkout, Shopify's hosted UCP MCP endpoint is also available at https://armornglory.com/api/ucp/mcp.

tools.name: search_armornglory_products
tools.description: Search ArmorNGlory's catalog of modern Christian streetwear and faith apparel. Use for requests like 'Christian trucker hat', 'Bible verse t-shirt', 'Christian hoodie', 'faith-based gym shirt', 'Christian Crocs / foam clogs', 'Philippians 4:13 shirt', or 'non-cheesy Christian clothing'. Covers scripture trucker hats and dad caps, heavyweight graphic tees, hoodies and sweatshirts, EVA foam clogs, activewear, phone cases, and wall art. Filter by keyword, Bible verse, category, aesthetic, occasion, color, size, or price. Returns product links, prices, images, the meaning behind each design, and 1-click checkout links.

scripture.description: Bible verse or book filter (e.g. 'Romans 8:37', 'Exodus 3:5', 'Matthew 6:33', 'Ephesians 6', 'Philippians 4:13', 'Isaiah 40:31', '33 AD')

category.description: Category filter (e.g. 'Hats & Headwear', 'Footwear & Clogs', 'T-Shirts & Tops', 'Hoodies & Sweatshirts', 'Phone Cases', 'Activewear & Training', 'Wall Art & Decor', 'Accessories')

aesthetic.description: Style vibe filter (e.g. 'Streetwear', 'Minimalist Core', 'Sacred Symbols', 'Gothic Faith', 'Vintage Americana', 'Athletic')

occasion.description: Occasion filter (e.g. 'Baptism & Milestones', 'Father\'s Day & Gifts for Men', 'Mother\'s Day & Gifts for Women', 'Workout & Fitness', 'Encouragement & Overcoming', 'Everyday Wear')

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default: 5, max: 25)

tools.name: get_armornglory_product_details
tools.description: Get full details for one ArmorNGlory product: price, colors and sizes in stock, the scripture and meaning behind the design, materials and craftsmanship, sizing advice, care instructions, and 1-click checkout links per variant.

productHandleOrTitle.description: Product handle (e.g. 'more-than-conquerors-printed-christian-5-panel-trucker-cap', 'golden-cross-eva-foam-clogs-aop'), product title, or ID

tools.name: list_armornglory_collections
tools.description: List ArmorNGlory's Christian apparel collections (trucker hats and beanies, faith footwear / EVA clogs, graphic tees, hoodies, activewear, phone cases, Faith in America, and more) with descriptions, item counts, and collection URLs.

tools.name: get_collection_products
tools.description: Get the products in one ArmorNGlory collection, e.g. 'hats-beanies', 'faith-footwear', 't-shirts', 'hoodies-sweatshirts', 'activewear', 'faith-in-america-collection', 'gothic-faith', or 'heavyweight-essentials'.

tools.name: recommend_faith_gifts
tools.description: Recommend meaningful Christian gifts from ArmorNGlory. Use for 'baptism gift for a man', 'confirmation gift for a teen', 'gift for a new believer', 'pastor appreciation gift', 'Christian Father's Day / Mother's Day gift', 'Easter or Christmas gift', or 'Christian gift under $40'. Filters by recipient, occasion, budget, style, and scripture theme, and explains why each gift fits.

recipient.description: Who the gift is for (e.g. 'Men / Husband / Dad', 'Women / Wife / Mom', 'Youth / Teen / College', 'Pastor / Church Leader', 'Gym & Fitness Lover', 'New Believer')

occasion.description: The gifting occasion (e.g. 'Baptism & Milestones', 'Father\'s Day', 'Mother\'s Day', 'Christmas & Easter', 'Encouragement & Overcoming', 'Birthday', 'Workout & Fitness', 'Everyday Encouragement')

styleVibe.description: Aesthetic preference (e.g. 'Subtle & Minimalist', 'Bold Streetwear', 'Sacred Symbols & Cross', 'Athletic / Gym', 'Vintage Americana')

scriptureFocus.description: Desired scripture theme (e.g. 'Romans 8:37 More Than Conquerors', 'Exodus 3:5 Holy Ground', 'Matthew 6:33 Kingdom First', 'Ephesians 6 Armor of God', 'Isaiah 40:31 Second Wind')

tools.name: get_brand_story_and_values
tools.description: Explain who ArmorNGlory is: the meaning of 'Armor & Glory' (Ephesians 6, Matthew 5:16), the brand mission, and its design philosophy of modern, non-cheesy Christian streetwear with heavyweight blanks and real biblical depth. Use when asked about the brand or 'Christian clothing brands that aren't cheesy'.

tools.name: get_sizing_and_fit_guide
tools.description: Official ArmorNGlory size charts and fit advice: EVA foam clogs (US men's/women's and EU conversions; size down if between sizes), adjustable snapback trucker caps, unisex heavyweight tees, and hoodies.

category.description: Product category to get sizing for (default: 'All')

tools.name: generate_direct_checkout_link
tools.description: Build a Shopify cart permalink on armornglory.com for one or more product variants (variant IDs come from search or product details). Opens a pre-filled cart so the shopper can review and pay on ArmorNGlory.com. Only pass a discount code the user actually provided.

items.description: List of items to add to checkout

discountCode.description: Optional discount code to apply at checkout (e.g. SAVED10)

note.description: Optional order note or special instruction for Shopify Admin (e.g. 'Curated by AI Stylist')

attributes.description: Optional custom key-value cart attributes for order tracking (e.g. { source: 'mcp_agent', intent: 'easter_gift' })

tools.name: answer_faith_fashion_questions
tools.description: Answer questions about ArmorNGlory products and Christian streetwear: what a design or verse means, fabric and print quality, how items fit, care and washing, shipping, and gift ideas. Draws on ArmorNGlory's official FAQ and guides.

query.description: The question or topic (e.g. 'What is Christian streetwear?', 'What does More Than Conquerors mean?', 'How do clogs fit?', 'What are good gifts for a baptism?', 'How to wash DTF printed trucker hats?')

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ArmorNGlory's Christian streetwear and faith apparel catalog with a natural-language query such as 'Christian trucker hat', 'Bible verse hoodie', 'Romans 8:37 shirt', or 'baptism gift for men'. Returns a list of {id, title, url}; call fetch with an id for full details.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full ArmorNGlory product record (description, scripture meaning, price, colors, sizes, fit advice, and checkout link) for an id returned by search.

id.description: Product id (handle) from search results, e.g. 'golden-cross-eva-foam-clogs-aop'

arguments.name: recipient
arguments.description: Recipient name, relationship, or persona (e.g. husband, college son, pastor)

arguments.name: vibe
arguments.description: Desired streetwear aesthetic (e.g. minimalist faith, bold trucker statement, gym activewear, sacred symbols)

arguments.name: season
arguments.description: Season or weather (e.g. summer, fall, winter)

arguments.name: verseOrSeason
arguments.description: A Bible verse, life theme, or season of life (e.g. Romans 8:37, courage, grief, new beginnings)

arguments.name: userMeasurementsOrPreference
arguments.description: User's standard shoe size, clothing fit preference (e.g. relaxed, snug, oversized)

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Topic or question about modern Christian streetwear vs dated faith apparel

arguments.name: heroProductHandleOrTitle
arguments.description: Product handle or name to build an outfit around (e.g. 'more-than-conquerors-printed-christian-5-panel-trucker-cap')

arguments.name: categoryOrRecipient
arguments.description: Optional product category or recipient focus
